author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
In the past, reusable perl/python scripts are common to the project team, your own IDE plugins/extensions, .vimrc are personal.  The line is pretty clear.

In the AI era, what should be common and what should be personal?  Is skill something common or something personal?   No one has the right answer at the moment.
